artist_notes.name: Cassy
artist_notes.note: Berlin house/techno DJ and longtime Panorama Bar-circuit regular; deep, hypnotic selector.

artist_notes.name: Konstantin
artist_notes.note: Giegling crew member; deep, left-field house and techno.

curator_note: A Giegling crew takeover with Cassy in the mix is the closest thing to a proper European club night this Halloween. Venue is still TBA, so watch for the reveal.
description: Giegling label-family night at a to-be-announced DTLA venue, with Cassy, Map.ache and Konstantin.

artist_notes.name: Derrick Carter
artist_notes.note: Chicago house veteran; funky, jackin' selector with decades of club history.

artist_notes.name: Kim Ann Foxman
artist_notes.note: Former Hercules & Love Affair vocalist turned DJ; disco-leaning house.

curator_note: Derrick Carter is the draw: Chicago funk-house from a guy who can play all night without a dull minute. Foxman pairs well and the 11 to 6 window means a real night.
description: Late-night SMD party headlined by Chicago house veteran Derrick Carter with Kim Ann Foxman, 11pm to 6am, venue TBA.

artist_notes.name: Claude VonStroke
artist_notes.note: Dirtybird founder; bass-heavy, playful house and tech-house.

artist_notes.name: The Blaze
artist_notes.note: French duo (cousins) known for cinematic live electronic sets.

curator_note: Big block-party fun: Dirtybird's boss, The Blaze live, and an Arcade Fire DJ set is an odd but exciting mix. Expect crowds and costumes, not a quiet groove.
description: Halloween block party in the Arts District with two stages, headlined by The Blaze live and Claude VonStroke (same event as The Maze listing).

curator_note: A free local bar night, and I couldn't verify the lineup. Fine for a drop-in if you are nearby, nothing to plan around.
description: Free Psychic Skin x Bug night at Blipsy Bar with local DJs.

artist_notes.name: Claude VonStroke
artist_notes.note: Dirtybird founder; bass-heavy, playful house and tech-house.

artist_notes.name: The Blaze
artist_notes.note: French duo (cousins) known for cinematic live electronic sets.

curator_note: Same Maze block party as the other listing, so pick one ticket link. The Blaze live plus Claude VonStroke makes it the biggest Halloween rave play of the weekend.
description: The Maze Halloween block party at Origin in the Arts District: Arcade Fire DJ set, The Blaze live, Claude VonStroke.

artist_notes.name: Deep Dish
artist_notes.note: Dubfire and Sharam; 90s progressive house legends reunited for touring sets.

curator_note: Deep Dish at Sound is a nostalgia pick that still delivers; the 30th anniversary-era sets are polished progressive house. Check which night the weekend pass covers.
description: Halloween weekend at Sound Nightclub in Hollywood headlined by Deep Dish, with Neil Frances; two-day pass available.

artist_notes.name: Lavenge
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ on the local house/disco circuit.

artist_notes.name: Max Rush
artist_notes.note: LA-scene DJ on the local house circuit.

curator_note: Free rooftop house from 3 to 9 on Halloween, which is the Sunset Sessions feel in costume. Get there early since free rooftops fill fast.
description: Free daytime-to-night Halloween rooftop party at Somewhere Special with JTJ, Lavenge, Max Rush and others.

artist_notes.name: Byron The Aquarius
artist_notes.note: Detroit-rooted house producer and DJ; deep, soulful, jazzy sets.

curator_note: Byron The Aquarius for an 11pm to 8am run is a real Detroit-flavored all-nighter. Cheap too, and location is TBA.
description: Overnight Disconic x Better Tomorrow party at a secret LA location with Detroit house producer Byron The Aquarius.

curator_note: A Halloween house party in Venice with a mostly local-scene bill; I could not verify the names. Decent if you want a smaller room.
description: Third Eye Lover x Moss Halloween party in Venice with Ardalan, marta aramini and more, venue TBA.

artist_notes.name: LSDXOXO
artist_notes.note: Philadelphia-born, NYC/Berlin-based producer; hard, ghetto-tech and club-bass blends.

artist_notes.name: shekdash
artist_notes.note: East Coast club DJ billed here as a heavyweight.

curator_note: A harder, sweatier club night than most Halloween offers, from LSDXOXO. Leans bass and club rather than house groove.
description: Halloween party at a secret DTLA venue with LSDXOXO and shekdash.

artist_notes.name: Brunello
artist_notes.note: Techno DJ and producer; I could not verify further details.

curator_note: Techno-leaning Halloween night at Ace Mission with Bambounou on the bill. The $95 ticket is steep for what is billed.
description: Factory 93 presents Brunello's Mellow Circus at Ace*Mission Studios with Bambounou.

artist_notes.name: AC Slater
artist_notes.note: Night Bass label founder; bass-house and tech-house with a big following.

curator_note: AC Slater at Academy is easy, high-energy bass-house fun. Not an underground play, but good for a Halloween weekend warm-up.
description: AC Slater, Night Bass label head, headlines Academy LA for Halloween weekend.
